snippet.title: Hard Drive Narrative Trailer - Rising Tide Challenge
snippet.description:
Explore the cyberpunk world of Hard Drive as you work as a driver and hacker in order to pay down your debts and uncover the secrets of the city.

FMV. Text Parser. Driving Game.
More than just a visual love letter to the neon-soaked 1980’s, the mechanics itself are retro in influence.
* Establish contacts and receive messages via the in-car VideoCom system.
* The hacking sections are true text parser interactions - where typing commands become key to navigating computer system. 
* Upgrade your vehicle to perform better in races and demolition derbies.

- - - - -
"Undertow" by ROAMER (https://roamerisaband.bandcamp.com/track/undertow)

Puppetry by Mad Dash Studios.

Additional video footage downloaded on [Coverr](https://coverr.co)
